title: Recreating Dauntless using AI
author: Laperen
selftext:
Missed this old game enough to start trying to re-create it. Working on the basic mechanics first.  
  
A pure web project, no game engine, no models from 3D modelling software. Rendering using ThreeJS framework.

Was made to this state in about a week on and off with ChatGPT 6 Astra and 6.1 Sol. Made bulk of dauntless knowledge into skills. Used videos I recorded back while I was playing the game, as reference for mechanics and timing.

Just giving AI a video and asking it to re-create it was, underwhelming. So when I attempted it again, I started with recreating a weapon moveset, followed by the behemoth. After combat was pretty darn close to the real thing, moved on to recreating a basic version of the loop while fighting on an island.

Can be played here:  
[https://laperen.github.io/doughty/](https://laperen.github.io/doughty/)

For anyone who played Dauntless before:

The version I enjoyed most of post Reforge and pre-Awakening, so that's the version I am aiming to re-create.

First weapon is Aether-Strikers, but rethemed as sword.

First behemoth is Embermane, with enrage mode. No Aether-charge mode yet.

If or when I get to the online features, the plan is for the hosted server to merely be a relay, passing over to peer-to-peer connections for group play.

comments.author: JWalter89
comments.body:
>After combat was pretty darn close to the real thing...

It's been a long time since I played Dauntless, but I'm fairly certain this is lightyears away from being close to how Dauntless' combat played out

replies.author: Laperen
replies.body: A lot of feedback is missing, especially the ones from animation, not to mention sound as well. Not to mention lantern abilities, omnicell abilities if you count it, and cell builds which would require creating that whole system before integration. But the core mechanics of the weapon and core behaviors of Embermane are there.
